What do other customers say in their reviews, does it actually hold up?
12:37
Independent customer reviews show that Cozey sofas hold up well over the long term, though experiences vary depending on the collection, care, and purchase date.
What customers praise:
Comfort and aesthetics: Reviews frequently highlight how comfortable the seating is and praise the modern design.
Modularity and convenience: Customers who move or reconfigure their living spaces often note that modularity is one of their favorite features, making moving and expanding easy without needing a brand-new sofa.
Long-term support: Because parts like cushions, covers, and individual modules can be swapped, owners appreciate being able to refresh worn components years later.
Common criticisms and areas for attention:
Cushion maintenance: For plush, loose-fill collections like Ciello and Gaia, some owners report cushions flattening or needing frequent fluffing. In response, we upgraded the high-density foam across our sofas to D35 in 2023 and added 3.8 cm (1.5 in) of extra base foam in 2026 to better cushion against the frame.
Fabric wear: Earlier reviews occasionally mentioned fabric pilling. In 2024, we discontinued earlier fabrics prone to excessive pilling and moved to tighter, more durable weaves, making those complaints much less frequent.
Delivery: Some reviews mention shipping delays or split deliveries arriving on different days.
Overall, our frames are designed for 20+ years, layered foam is expected to last 7–10 years, and loose-cushion foam cores 10+ years. If you want a sofa that holds its shape with minimal effort over the years, layered-foam collections like Atmosphere, Cassini, or Neptune generally receive the fewest maintenance concerns.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
12:39
To get the best result and maximize the lifespan of your sofa, here are the key care and usage guidelines:
Routine cleaning & washing:
For routine deep cleaning, washing removable covers every one to two years is a good starting point.
When machine-washing removable covers, wash in cold water using a mild, fragrance-free detergent.
Turn the covers inside out and close all zippers before washing to protect the fabric.
For drying:
Aquaforte covers: You can tumble dry on a no-heat setting, hang them to air dry, or lay them flat to dry. (Keep in mind that frequent washing can gradually reduce the natural water resistance of Snowdrift Aquaforte™ fabric.)
Other fabrics: Lay flat to air-dry and never use a tumble dryer. Always ensure covers are completely dry before putting them back on.
Address spills promptly: While fabrics like Aquaforte Velvet have excellent water and stain resistance, no fabric is completely stain-proof, so clean up food and drink messes as soon as they happen.
Fabric care (pilling & snags):
Light pilling is normal with everyday friction; use a fabric shaver gently to remove surface pills and keep the fabric looking fresh.
If a thread snags, carefully trim the protruding thread with scissors rather than pulling it.
Cushion maintenance:
If you choose a layered-foam sofa (like Atmosphere, Neptune, or Cassini), minimal routine cushion maintenance is required as the foam is designed to hold its shape.
If you choose a loose foam-and-fiber sofa (like Ciello or Gaia), fluff and rotate the cushions every one to two weeks to redistribute the filling and prevent uneven settling.
Even wear: Where your layout allows, rotate cushions between frequently used and less-used spots so they age evenly.
